notes: Inbound lead from product hunt referral; signed up via self-serve quickstart.
Primary contact: Maya R. (Head of Growth) — small engineering team, high volume of long product descriptions.
Cost sensitivity: high. Running a chat support bot + product Q&A against ~12k product pages. Concerned about per-ticket token cost.
Wants practical cost levers: batching, response-level caching (prefix + doc-level), prompt compression, stop token tuning.
Ask: 'Can you show me 3 concrete config changes that save >30% on tokens without hurting quality?'
Prefers hosted API (public cloud) — no VPC/on-prem at this stage. SOC2 + audit log exports required for compliance review.
Quoted: 'We want to stay self-serve but need an audited path to cost predictability before expanding.'
Short-term goal: token usage audit + sample batching POC on 1 support flow. Long-term: consider Dedicated if monthly spend >$10k and latency demands rise.
use_case_summary: D2C ecommerce: chat support bot + product Q&A/embedding search. Large doc corpus leads to high token usage. Immediate ask: token audit and recommendations for batching, caching, and prompt compression on hosted API (public cloud). SOC2 + audit logs required.
poc_plan: Phase 1: Token audit — run sample prompts through estimator, produce per-flow token breakdown
Phase 2: Implement response batching on support flow (group similar user events, test latency impact)
Phase 3: Add prefix/document-level caching for top 20% of queries, measure hit rate
Phase 4: Apply prompt compression — shorter system prompts, template compression, test quality regression on eval set
Phase 5: Report savings, recommend thresholds to trigger Dedicated evaluation
